title: Abide with Me
artist: William Henry Monk / Henry Francis Lyte
attribution: Words by Henry Francis Lyte (1847; he died that year), sung to the tune "Eventide" written by William Henry Monk for Hymns Ancient and Modern (1861; he died in 1889). Melody and words are public domain worldwide. The F sharp on "abide" (end of the second line) is a chromatic note of the original tune and is expected to show as out-of-key.
